title.rendered: Minoxidil Hair Loss Review vs Kiierr

content.rendered:
Hair loss is not uncommon when it comes to enlisting problems-related to beauty. It has become a concern for many people, both men and women, no matter the age. Genetics and aging are some of the main underlying causes of hair thinning and may cause baldness. That is to say, dealing with problems like these is no fun. In fact, it can be overwhelming for people to find the right products that work for their type of hair and help it regrow.

The good news is that there are plenty of products available on the market to help you reverse or avoid hair loss. From drugs that prevent hair loss from low-level light therapy caps, there are many ways to rejuvenate your hair follicles. So if you think you can never have lush, voluminous hair again or that a hair transplant is your only option, you might be wrong.

With treatments like minoxidil and laser caps, you can easily stop or slow down hair thinning. You can even regrow your hair you thought was gone forever. Both these treatments can be effective and can help you produce stronger and thicker locks. However, you must go through each hair growth treatment’s pros and cons before applying, eating, or wearing one to evaluate which will suit you the best.

Here we have reviewed two popular hair growth treatments to help you make an informed decision. Read on to learn more about Minoxidil hair loss review vs Kiierr.

What is Minoxidil for Hair Loss?

Minoxidil is one of the common vasodilators, which means it is the medication that dilates blood vessels. The medicine affects the muscles of your veins and arteries of the heart walls. It not only improves blood flow in different parts but also prevents muscles from tightening. Minoxidil is an over-the-counter medication that has FDA’s approval for reducing hair loss in men and women.

Although scientists are still studying the mechanism of Minoxidil, they believe that it interacts with your scalp sulfotransferase when you apply it topically in the foam and serum form. Sulfotransferase converts Minoxidil into sulfate and becomes an active form of medicine.  

Once the conversion happens, it shortens the telogen phase of your hair (the phase when your locks are resting and begin the hair thinning process). The same phase pushes hair into the anagen phase, which is the growth phase. The premature phase extends the hair growth period and helps your hair grow longer and thicker.

Minoxidil Proper Use

Minoxidil typically comes with patient instructions, like many other medications on the market. Make sure to read the instructions carefully and consult your doctor with any questions that you may have about the product. 

Use the medicine as directed and only use it as often as your doctor or bottle label indicates. It is important to not use this medication on other areas of the body aside from your scalp.

The dose for each individual will depend on many factors and can vary from each individual. If you miss a dose, you can apply the missed dose as soon as you notice according to Mayo Clinic. If when you notice is close to your next dose, skip your missed dose and remain on your original schedule.

Monoxidil Foam vs Liquid

The following will discuss the proper application of Minoxidil foam vs liquid according to the Mayo Clinic.

To apply minoxidil topical foam:

  • Open the container by matching the arrows on the ring and cap. Twist and pull it off once arrows are lined up.

  • Part your hair to fully expose the areas on the scalp that are thinning.

  • Turn the can upside down to allow foam to come out on your fingers.

  • Spread the foam over the problematic areas of the scalp experiencing thinning and gently massage foam into these areas.

  • Once you have finished application, put the lid back on the can and wash your hands to get rid of any excess medication.

To apply minoxidil topical solution:

  • You will want to make sure your hair and scalp are completely dry.

  • Apply the prescribed amount of topical solution on the thinning areas of the scalp. 

  • Do not shampoo your hair for 4 hours after applying minoxidil.

  • After applying medicine to the scalp, wash your hands. 

  • Stay away from using a blow dryer and let the hair naturally dry after applying the solution.

  • Allow the minoxidil to completely dry after application. Minoxidil can stain clothing, hats, or bed linen if your hair or scalp is not fully dry after using the medicine.

Minoxidil Expiration Date

Believe it or not, Minoxidil does expire. You can find the expiration date printed on the bottle label as well as on the outside of the box when purchased. According to a medical expert on Quora , Minoxidil can lose its potency over time and might not be as effective if you use it after the expiration date listed.

Minoxidil Pills: Are There Side Effects?

Minoxidil is FDA-approved for safe and effective use among men and women. Keep in mind, that there has still been reported side effects after application of the product.

According to the National Library of Medicine, Minoxidil may cause the following side effects: 

1.) Dryness

2.) Itching

3.) Scalp Irritation

4.) Scaling

5.) Interactions with other drugs/medications

Keep in mind that among these possible side effects, Minoxidil doesn’t rescue your receding hairline. It works best for those individuals suffering from Androgenetic Alopecia (AGA), considering this condition is what Minoxidil was originally made to treat. So, it is important to know that Minoxidil is not effective in curing baldness. That means when you stop using Minoxidil; the hair fall may start again. It is possible that you may start losing hair faster than before.

Is it True About Minoxidil Causing Hair Loss?

According to HIMS, hair loss can occur in the beginning stages of using Minoxidil. This is due to the hair follicles rapidly entering into the telogen stage of the hair growth cycle before being able to reach the anagen (growth) stage of the hair growth cycle. This is normal and how Minoxidil works.

Some individuals have reported noticing hair loss if they discontinue taking the medication. There is no researched or proven evidence that this is a side effect from eliminating using Minoxidil in your hair routine.

What is Kiierr?

Kiierr laser hair growth cap is a raging trend in the world of hair treatment. From revitalizing hair follicles to stimulating hair growth, Kiierr offers advanced low-level laser therapy (LLLT) for thinning hair in both men and women. 

Many studies have shown that LLLT is effective in stopping hair thinning in the early stage. The LLLT cap of Kiierr is an FDA-cleared hair treatment that can help reduce problems associated with hair loss. The therapy can be extremely effective for the people suffering from hair thinning disorder called androgenic alopecia.  

Laser cap therapy stimulates hair growth by delivering laser lights to the scalp. It energizes and activates hair follicles to promote hair growth. The cap is tremendously advantageous when it comes to stimulating hair growth painlessly. What makes this therapy one of the best hair growth options is that you can use this cap in the comfort of your home. 

It amplifies your body functions to reinforce hair growth. The process can accelerate hair healing and regeneration by shedding useless cells. Kiierr is a safe and reliable method that helps you make room for new and healthier hair follicles. 

Minoxidil Hair Growth Review vs. Kiierr

 Both Minoxidil and Kiierr are clinically proven hair restoration treatments. They are powerful enough to reverse your hair loss. However, when it comes to reviewing their pros and cons, Kiierr makes a better and safer option. We have come to this conclusion because Kiierr has no known side effects from completing LLLT therapy treatment. The process is an all natural way to regrow the hair follicles on the scalp.

You can experience mild to severe side effects while using Minoxidil, and the treatment therapy is not a natural hair growing method.

Kiierr, on the other hand, gives you promising results and is safe to use for promoting hair growth. Pain-free technology can help those experiencing hair thinning to regrow your hair thicker and fuller than ever before!

Conclusion

Overall, you may have several choices for your hair loss solution. However, not all hair loss treatment methods are safe and reliable. Thus, Kiierr laser cap treatment is safe, reliable, and a long term solution to your hair loss issue. It has no known side effects and is clinically proven and FDA-cleared to  promote hair growth naturally! Start your hair growth journey with Kiierr today!
